purpose: Prospective ARM-first bounded single-initialization gate; no blanket repair or no-regression claim

rules.primaryPass: All arms valid; acceptance upper<=1.02 AND repair upper<1 AND bridge lower>1.02.
rules.controlPass: All arms valid; acceptance upper<=1.02 AND repair upper<=1.02. x64 reexport also needs acceptance upper<1.
rules.stage2: Only after stage1 completed with integrity true, primaryPass and both ARM controlPass. Otherwise stage2 is not run.
rules.aa: Any dedicated A/A point outside[1/1.02,1.02] with CI excluding1 invalidates the case; never normalize.
rules.short: Any measured-subject warmup or sample<20ms invalidates the case; retain all fixed samples.
rules.stopping: One non-forced push, run_attempt1. Hard failure stops that job; no timing-selected reruns, replacements, extra quartets, pooling or exclusions.
rules.followup: Any inconclusive/invalid control blocks progression. A later confirmation requires a separately declared protocol and review, retains this run, and cannot replace or pool it.
rules.memory: Original setup deltas are descriptive only. Untimed instrumented Map-expression counts are separate from retained heap, settled topology and latency.

samplingUnit: Mean of two adjacent-pair log ratios per fresh-process quartet; process median7 batches; no batch pseudoreplication
work: All three-source pilots for every case in a stage finish before any measurement. Maximum prescription freezes one common count per case. No later adjustment.
ordering: Case order fixed by manifest. Within each quartet, seeded shuffle of arms; each arm has exactly half ABBA and half BAAB. Source-independent pilot order frozen prospectively.
reporting: Every direct contrast and A/A interval remains visible, including invalid/adverse/inconclusive outcomes; setup heap deltas descriptive only; no normalization or pooling
stage2FailureStatus: Not run when ARM primary/control/integrity conditions fail; this is not a successful x64 result
